method: Original sources are classified with GCC and Clang in C11, GNU11, and pedantic C11 modes. The chosen compiler's -E -P output is validated by that same compiler before the Toucan acceptance comparison. Sources are never linked or executed; this is not an ABI, runtime, or Toucan preprocessing conformance test.
scope: Compact transcription of the existing acceptance audit; the compiler commands were not rerun. Exit-code arrays follow compiler_modes. Full raw per-case records and command records are hashed; the remaining exploratory difference retains verbatim diagnostics in a sibling report. This is not runtime, ABI, or native-preprocessor evidence.
